Annotation Interface Action

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface Action
Marks a method of a simulation model (public, without parameters) as an action: a button in the settings of Bio7 and of the HTML export (e.g., "Add a glider"). The view is updated after the call. The buttons of a group are shown below the settings of the group (sorted by the label).
